h1: Huntington Heat Pump Rebates 2026: PSEG Long Island
lead: What Huntington homeowners can really get in 2026, checked against PSEG Long Island and NYSERDA on October 3, 2026.
cards_heading: What you can claim in Huntington in 2026
cards_intro:
Short answer: In Huntington, the main heat pump rebate is PSEG Long Island’s heat pump rebate: $4,000 (or $5,000–$7,500 if you qualify on income or live in a DAC) for a whole-home system, taken off your contractor’s bill. It is one rebate, not several that add up. Lower-income households can get much more through EmPower+, and the federal tax credits ended on December 31, 2025.

sections:
Huntington is a Suffolk County town on the North Shore. PSEG Long Island supplies electricity and National Grid supplies gas where lines exist. Larger older homes here often need a multi-zone system, so get a room-by-room load calculation (Manual J); PSEG requires whole-home sizing.

The Town of Huntington has run its own energy programs in the past, including one that paired residents with local energy auditors. Ask the town what is running now.

Many North Shore homes sit on hills with long driveways and big lots, so there is usually room for outdoor units, but older wiring may need an upgrade.

Long Island is not part of NYS Clean Heat, so there is no second state rebate. There is no separate federal HEAR cheque: New York delivers it through EmPower+. The federal 25C/25D tax credits ended December 31, 2025.

Income-qualified? EmPower+ can cover far more than the utility rebate. Check the state DAC map too: it can raise your amount.
claim_heading: What to do next in Huntington
claim_steps: Ask the Town of Huntington if any local energy program is open.
Get a Manual J load calculation; PSEG needs whole-home sizing.
Get 2–3 quotes and ask each contractor to show the rebate tier on the quote.
faq: How much is the heat pump rebate in Huntington?

PSEG Long Island’s heat pump rebate pays $4,000 (or $5,000–$7,500 if you qualify on income or live in a DAC) for a whole-home heat pump in Huntington, depending on home size, whether you remove the old system, and DAC status.
Why does PSEG Long Island require whole-home sizing?
PSEG's heat pump rebate is for a system sized to heat the entire home, so contractors must show a load calculation. A single ductless head for one room will not qualify.
Is the federal tax credit still available for heat pumps?
No. The federal 25C and 25D credits ended for anything installed after December 31, 2025.

Lower-income owners and renters of 1-4 family homes. Low-income households can get free upgrades up to $12,000 upstate or $14,000 downstate; moderate-income households get 50% covered up to $6,000 upstate or $7,000 downstate.
